description: Defines the interface for managing application lifecycle states, including notifications, registration, and control functions within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: ILifecycleManagerState
classes.description: Interface for managing application lifecycle states, including notification registration, app readiness, state change completion, and app closure.

classes.name: ILifecycleManagerState::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for receiving application lifecycle state change events.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification interface to receive lifecycle events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification interface.

methods.name: AppReady
methods.description: Signals that an application is ready.

methods.name: StateChangeComplete
methods.description: Indicates completion of a state change for an application.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes the specified application with a given reason.
